individuals.title: Wikimedia Enterprise
individuals.quote: Wikimedia Enterprise is a service of the Wikimedia Foundation available via enterprise.wikimedia.com.

individuals.title: Wikimedia Foundation
individuals.quote: Given the nature of the service, primary decision making for it will rest with the Wikimedia Foundation.

individuals.title: Build services for high-volume commercial reusers
individuals.quote: The goal of the service is to build services for high-volume commercial reusers of Wikimedia content.

individuals.title: High-volume commercial reusers
individuals.quote: The focus is on organizations that want to repurpose Wikimedia content in other contexts, providing data services at a large scale

individuals.title: Improve reader experience, reach and attribution
individuals.quote: Wikimedia Enterprise aims to improve the user experience of Wikimedia's readers beyond our own websites; increase the reach and discoverability of the content; and improve awareness and ease of attribution and verifiability

individuals.title: High barrier to entry for using Wikimedia data
individuals.quote: There is a very high barrier to entry for using Wikimedia data, outside of the common use cases of reading or editing.

individuals.title: Movement Strategy recommendations
individuals.quote: the Movement Strategy recommendations (2020) represent the culmination of wide-ranging consultation across the Wikimedia community and stakeholders about our future

individuals.title: Explore revenue generation via enterprise-level APIs
individuals.quote: Explore new opportunities for both revenue generation and free knowledge dissemination through partnerships and earned income—for example...Building enterprise-level APIs

individuals.title: Make Wikimedia API suite more comprehensive and reliable
individuals.quote: Make the Wikimedia API suite more comprehensive, reliable, secure and fast, in partnership with large scale users

individuals.title: Companies should reinvest in Wikimedia communities
individuals.quote: There has long been a feeling among community members that these companies should do more to reinvest in the Wikimedia communities for the benefits they gain from the content and resources they use.

individuals.title: Community members
individuals.quote: There has long been a feeling among community members

individuals.title: Revenue mainly from few heavy for-profit users
individuals.quote: Most financial benefit for Wikimedia would likely only come from a very small handful of heavy for-profit users, and would feed back into the Wikimedia movement.

individuals.title: Wikimedia movement
individuals.quote: along with the wider Wikimedia movement

individuals.title: Democratize data for less-resourced organizations
individuals.quote: there is a responsibility to democratize our data for organizations that do not possess the resources of these largest users

individuals.title: Universities and university researchers
individuals.quote: but also for universities and university researchers; archives and archivists

individuals.title: Archives and archivists
individuals.quote: archives and archivists; along with the wider Wikimedia movement

individuals.title: Frequency: regular current snapshots
individuals.quote: Regular current snapshots of Wikimedia projects

individuals.title: Reliability: dependable accessible infrastructure
individuals.quote: Dependable, accessible infrastructure

individuals.title: Quality: best last revision
individuals.quote: a “best last revision”

individuals.title: Content program goal
individuals.quote: Make more of our movement's content available in consistent machine-readable formats, freely available for all researchers and re-users.

individuals.title: Resource-load program goal
individuals.quote: Reduce the need for high-intensity site-scraping by the highest-frequency and highest-volume reusers, which currently target our production servers.

individuals.title: Fundraising program goal
individuals.quote: Provide a clearer and more consistent way for the largest re-users to reinvest derived benefits back to the movement, instead of making occasional altruistic donations that vary in size.

individuals.title: Community editing tools out of scope
individuals.quote: This includes the majority of community editing tools, which will be out of scope for this service.

individuals.title: Wikimedia projects remain libre
individuals.quote: The principles of free cultural works mean that anyone can use Wikimedia without restriction, including commercially.

individuals.title: Reject non-commercial licenses
individuals.quote: It is why we reject ‘non-commercial’ licenses, as they would limit the kinds of reuse possible.

individuals.title: Wikimedia projects remain gratis
individuals.quote: The ability to freely access the knowledge available across all Wikimedia projects has always been core to the mission of the Foundation and the movement.

individuals.title: Movement never received revenue benefits
individuals.quote: Outside of voluntary corporate donations to the Wikimedia Foundation, the movement has never received benefits from any of this revenue through return investment.

individuals.title: Avoid revenue dependencies in product design
individuals.quote: taking care to avoid revenue dependencies or other undue external influence in product design and development

individuals.title: Enterprise use not required for for-profit reuse
individuals.quote: Use of this offering will not be required for for-profit content reuse; companies can continue to use the current tools available at no cost.

individuals.title: All Enterprise API revenue supports Wikimedia mission
individuals.quote: All Enterprise API revenue will unequivocally be used to support the Wikimedia mission—for example, to fund Wikimedia programs or help grow the Wikimedia Endowment.

individuals.title: Wikimedia Endowment
individuals.quote: help grow the Wikimedia Endowment

individuals.title: Access for all principle
individuals.quote: in accordance with the project's principle of *access for all*, there are also various ways to access the Wikimedia Enterprise APIs for free

individuals.title: Paid account
individuals.quote: paid access for large commercial organisations, with associated Service Level Agreements and dedicated customer support

individuals.title: Service Level Agreements
individuals.quote: Contracted accounts receive 99% SLA and support response-time guarantees.

individuals.title: Free account
individuals.quote: Creating a free account on the official website and using the Enterprise API access for free accounts.

individuals.title: Wikimedia Cloud Services
individuals.quote: Using Wikimedia Cloud Services. You get the same access as a paid account when making a call to any Enterprise API endpoint from within PAWS, Wikimedia Cloud VPS, or Toolforge.

individuals.title: PAWS
individuals.quote: from within PAWS, Wikimedia Cloud VPS, or Toolforge

individuals.title: Wikimedia Cloud VPS
individuals.quote: from within PAWS, Wikimedia Cloud VPS, or Toolforge

individuals.title: Toolforge
individuals.quote: from within PAWS, Wikimedia Cloud VPS, or Toolforge

individuals.title: Structured Contents (beta) datasets
individuals.quote: Downloading Structured Contents (beta) datasets hosted on third-party platforms.

individuals.title: Exceptional access
individuals.quote: you may request free **exceptional access** to the higher rate of the Enterprise APIs

individuals.title: Exceptional access request review
individuals.quote: Requests will be reviewed by *Wikimedia Foundation* staff in accordance with the following criteria, and granted at the Wikimedia Foundation's discretion.

individuals.title: Wikimedia Deutschland
individuals.quote: If the request includes substantive access to *Wikidata* content, the request will be reviewed in coordination with staff from *Wikimedia Deutschland*.

individuals.title: Who criterion
individuals.quote: is requesting exceptional access? Please list the contact person’s name, organisation (if applicable), email address, and *Enterprise* API account username.

individuals.title: What criterion
individuals.quote: is the request for? Please specify what specific exception is being requested, and for what purpose.

individuals.title: Need criterion
individuals.quote: Can the intended use-case be fulfilled via any of the existing free access methods?

individuals.title: Obligation criterion
individuals.quote: Would the intended use case require custom development to support or maintain? What is the duration of the requested exception?

individuals.title: Mission alignment criterion
individuals.quote: Is the intended use case aligned with any of the needs identified in the Movement Strategy Recommendations?

individuals.title: Values alignment criterion
individuals.quote: Do the requester’s professional practices or business model align with Wikimedia’s values?

individuals.title: Abide by copyright licenses
individuals.quote: All users of Wikimedia Enterprise services must abide by the copyright licenses on Wikimedia content. They are inherent and cannot be waived.

individuals.title: Exhaust standard options before exceptional access
individuals.quote: Exceptional free access to a paid account can only be granted when all standard options are exhausted – including the free account of the Enterprise services.

individuals.title: Non-exclusivity principle
individuals.quote: In accordance with the Wikimedia Enterprise operating principles regarding non-exclusivity, any newly developed software feature or dataset must be made available to all.

individuals.title: No closed knowledge silos or proprietary forks
individuals.quote: The proposed use-case should not deliberately create or reinforce closed knowledge silos, proprietary forks of the content, or circumvent community norms or policies.

individuals.title: Human rights assessment
individuals.quote: A human rights assessment is undertaken by the WMF for certain users of paid accounts for the Enterprise APIs (regardless of payment or exceptional access)

individuals.title: Human Rights Policy
individuals.quote: in accordance with the Human Rights Policy and Commercial Sales and Contracts Policy

individuals.title: Commercial Sales and Contracts Policy
individuals.quote: The LLC is subject to the governance of the Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees as described on the *Wikimedia Foundation Commercial Sales and Contracts Policy*.

individuals.title: Demonstrate commitment to open knowledge
individuals.quote: in order to receive free access to a paid account, the user should also be able to demonstrate a commitment to open knowledge, transparency, and/or public-benefit mission

individuals.title: Business model not in conflict with Wikimedia values
individuals.quote: The business-model should at the very least not be in conflict with Wikimedia’s values

individuals.title: Structured JSON response format
individuals.quote: All of our APIs return the same structured JSON (or ND-JSON) response format making it easy to augment one API with another.

individuals.title: Snapshot API
individuals.quote: The Enterprise Snapshot API allows users to retrieve entire Wikimedia projects as a database dump file.

individuals.title: On-demand API
individuals.quote: The Wikimedia Enterprise On-demand API allows users to retrieve single articles from any supported Wikimedia project at anytime.

individuals.title: Realtime API
individuals.quote: The Enterprise Realtime API allows users to stream updates in real-time from any supported Wikimedia project.

individuals.title: Wikimedia Dumps
individuals.quote: For high-volume reusers that currently rely on the Wikimedia Dumps to access our information

individuals.title: EventStream
individuals.quote: using EventStream APIs to access such changes

individuals.title: RESTBase
individuals.quote: depend on services like RESTBase to pull HTML from page titles and current revisions to update their products

individuals.title: Compressed project dumps
individuals.quote: Compressed dumps (in both wikitext and HTML) of supported text-based Wikimedia projects, updated monthly on a free account and weekly or daily on a paid account

individuals.title: Retrieve documents by name
individuals.quote: Make standard HTTP requests to retrieve documents by name from all supported projects and languages with filters available to limit response

individuals.title: Streaming updates
individuals.quote: Streaming: Receive streaming (firehose) updates of every change as they occur in real-time

individuals.title: Batch changed-article files
individuals.quote: Batch: Download compressed files of all articles that were changed, generated hourly

individuals.title: Filtering of events
individuals.quote: Filtering of events by Project or Revision Namespace

individuals.title: Filter received changes
individuals.quote: High-volume reusers are interested in a service that will allow them to filter the changes they receive to limit their processing

individuals.title: Stable HTTP connections without data loss
individuals.quote: guarantee stable HTTP connections to ensure no data loss

individuals.title: More useful schema to limit API calls
individuals.quote: supply a more useful schema to limit the number of API calls they need to make per event

individuals.title: Launch October 2021
individuals.quote: The service was announced in March 2021 (blogpost, WIRED article) and launched in October 2021

individuals.title: Commercial Partnerships
individuals.quote: The Wikimedia Enterprise project is helmed by the **Commercial Partnerships** division, which sits under the Advancement Department in the Wikimedia Foundation.

individuals.title: Advancement Department
individuals.quote: which sits under the Advancement Department in the Wikimedia Foundation

individuals.title: Technical Partnerships team
individuals.quote: to reflect the inclusion of the Technical Partnerships team

individuals.title: PartnerHero
individuals.quote: **PartnerHero** provide customer support services

individuals.title: Customer support services
individuals.quote: PartnerHero** provide customer support services

individuals.title: Vuurr
individuals.quote: **Vuurr** are assisting our sales process

individuals.title: Sales process
individuals.quote: Vuurr** are assisting our sales process

individuals.title: Super Natural Design
individuals.quote: **Super Natural Design** are the designers of the project website

individuals.title: Perrine Winkler
individuals.quote: **Perrine Winkler** has been contracted to help with rebranding the team behind Enterprise to Commercial Partnerships

individuals.title: Speed & Function
individuals.quote: Engineering support was provided in the first years by **Speed & Function**.

individuals.title: The LLC
individuals.quote: The board of the LLC overseeing the project are *Ex officio* from Wikimedia Foundation leadership

individuals.title: Sheetal Puri
individuals.quote: This includes the Chief Advancement Officer Sheetal Puri

individuals.title: Stephen LaPorte
individuals.quote: General Counsel Stephen LaPorte

individuals.title: Selena Deckelman
individuals.quote: Chief Product and Technology Officer Selena Deckelman

individuals.title: Lane Becker
individuals.quote: Lane Becker who serves as the LLC's president

individuals.title: Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees
individuals.quote: The LLC is subject to the governance of the Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees

individuals.title: Wikimedia Foundation Governance website
individuals.quote: All reports and official documents of the LLC are published on a dedicated Wikimedia Enterprise page on the **Wikimedia Foundation Governance** website.
